lane_matrix.note: percent of total weight, source lane = row; FF by node-level order; diagonal = intra-lane

flow_hierarchy_test.note: rho of flow ordinal (aff<intr<eff) vs champion rank; label permutation null; p is a <= bound at the 1/perms floor

nt_direction._note: top_nt is the Male CNS consensus prediction (malecns_ann.csv.gz), Kenyon cells set to acetylcholine; 'unclear' and missing are NA. Not ground truth

nt_stats.note: absolute synapse weight by SOURCE neuron's predicted transmitter (Male CNS consensus_nt); ff by the node-level order

sink_audit.note: cells with >50% zero-out-weight members are hatched grey

spectral.weights: log1p of undirected collapsed synapse counts
spectral.operator: tau-regularized random-walk (D+tau I)^-1 (W + tau/n J), deflated power iteration; within-lane use is ORDINAL (rank)
